info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: ' dAti dAyati dAp dEpoH dayate rakzaRe qitaH ' (Slo. 4) iti devaH .

examples: 'SaNkanIye deSe pUrvApadAne ca gfhItamanuyuYjIta' (kO0 a0 2.36.36). apadAnamapacAro durvfttam. avadAnaM tu sotkarzaM caritaM Bavati nirvyUQam ityapAvayorBedaH.
'yezAM trIRyavadAtAni vidyA yoniSca karma ca' (pA0 4.1.48 sUtre BAzye). avadAtAni=SudDAni.
'yaTEva kzetranirdAtA nirdAtaM kzetrameva ca' (BA0 SA0 97.6). nirdAtA=tfRAdyapanayena SoDakaH.
'yaTodDarati nirdAtA kakzaM DAnyaM ca rakzati' (manu0 7.110). ukto'rTaH.
'DanurAdAyamAnastu jAnuByAmagamanmahIm' (BA0 Adi0 18.25). AdAyamAnaH=AdAyan=parIkzamARaH. SunDanniti tu SabdArTaH.
